post.summary: Move this browser's unauthenticated user into the signed-in account
post.description: Requires both a bearer access token and the PolicyEngine-Unauthenticated-User header. When the signed-in identity has no account yet, the unauthenticated user becomes it in place, keeping its ID and records (converted). When the identity already has an account, every record moves to that account with its ID unchanged and the unauthenticated user is deleted (merged). When the header names no unauthenticated user, including a signed-in account's ID, nothing moves (none). The response is the signed-in account.

AdminInvitationItem.title: AdminInvitationItem
AdminInvitationItem.description:
An invitation as admins see it.

``invited_by_user_id`` is the admin who created or last resent it, null
once that account is deleted. ``expired`` says ``expires_at`` has passed:
it can't be accepted, but it can be resent. ``last_sent_at`` is when
Postmark accepted the email with the current link, null when the last
send failed or wasn't tried; ``last_send_error`` then names why, as a
short identifier such as ``not_configured``, ``timeout``, ``http_500``
or ``postmark_406`` (an address Postmark suppresses).

AdminInvitationPageResponse.title: AdminInvitationPageResponse
AdminInvitationPageResponse.description: Success response holding one page of open invitations.

AdminInvitationPageResult.title: AdminInvitationPageResult
AdminInvitationPageResult.description: One page of open invitations, newest first.

AdminUserItem.title: AdminUserItem
AdminUserItem.description:
A signed-in user as admins see it.

With Auth0 user profile settings, ``email``, ``first_name`` and
``last_name`` are read from Auth0 for each request and never stored: the
user's sign-in identities from the users' Auth0 tenant are looked up, the
most recently seen first, and a verified email comes before an unverified
one. Where Auth0 has no value, or can't answer, the stored value is
returned: the email of the most recently seen of the user's identities
that has one, else the user's own, and the user's stored names. When
neither has a first or last name, Auth0's full name, if it isn't an
email address, is the first name. ``last_seen_at`` is when the user's
most recently seen identity was last seen.

AdminUserPageResponse.title: AdminUserPageResponse
AdminUserPageResponse.description: The response for a page of signed-in users.

AdminUserPageResult.title: AdminUserPageResult
AdminUserPageResult.description: One page of signed-in users, newest first.

AdminUserResponse.title: AdminUserResponse
AdminUserResponse.description: The response for one signed-in user.

AgePoverty.title: AgePoverty
AgePoverty.description: Poverty rates for children, adults, seniors and everyone.

BaselineReformValue.title: BaselineReformValue
BaselineReformValue.description: A measure's value under the baseline and under the reform.

BudgetaryImpact.title: BudgetaryImpact
BudgetaryImpact.description:
The reform's headline budget effect in the simulated year.

Impacts are reform minus baseline totals in the country's currency;
``budgetary_impact`` is ``tax_revenue_impact`` minus
``benefit_spending_impact``, and ``state_tax_revenue_impact`` is US state
income tax (0 for the UK). ``households`` is the weighted number of
households and ``baseline_net_income`` their total baseline net income.

CliffImpact.title: CliffImpact
CliffImpact.description: Exposure to tax-benefit cliffs under the baseline and under the reform.

CliffImpactInSimulation.title: CliffImpactInSimulation
CliffImpactInSimulation.description: Net income lost to a small earnings rise, and the share of adults on a cliff.

CongressionalDistrictImpact.title: CongressionalDistrictImpact
CongressionalDistrictImpact.description:
The reform's impact in one US congressional district.

``district`` is the state and two-digit number, such as ``"CA-12"``; an
at-large district is ``01``. The percentages are the shares of people
whose household net income rises, falls or stays the same.

CongressionalDistrictImpacts.title: CongressionalDistrictImpacts
CongressionalDistrictImpacts.description: The reform's impact in each congressional district of a US state report.

ConstituencyImpact.title: ConstituencyImpact
ConstituencyImpact.description: The reform's impact in one UK parliamentary constituency.

CountryItem.title: CountryItem
CountryItem.description:
One served country and the calculations it supports.

``id`` is the value other v2 resources take as ``country_id``.
``household_enabled`` means household calculations and saved households
are available; ``society_wide_enabled`` means society-wide reports are,
and is only set for a country that is also household enabled.

CountryListResponse.title: CountryListResponse
CountryListResponse.description: Success envelope: ``status`` "ok", a null ``message`` and the countries.

CreatedReportUnreadableResponse.title: CreatedReportUnreadableResponse
CreatedReportUnreadableResponse.description:
The 502 answer when the created report cannot be read back.

The simulation service created ``report_id``, so the caller reads it
with ``GET /v2/reports/{report_id}`` rather than submitting it again.

CreatedSimulationUnreadableResponse.title: CreatedSimulationUnreadableResponse
CreatedSimulationUnreadableResponse.description:
The 502 answer when the created simulation cannot be read back.

The simulation service created ``simulation_id``, so the caller reads it
with ``GET /v2/simulations/{simulation_id}`` rather than submitting it
again.

DecileChange.title: DecileChange
DecileChange.description:
The change in average household net income in each decile, ``"1"`` to ``"10"``.

``average`` is the absolute change and ``relative`` the change as a
fraction of the decile's baseline average.

DeploymentResponse.title: DeploymentResponse
DeploymentResponse.description:
The policyengine.py version this revision serves, and since when.

``policyengine_version_live_since`` is when this .py version first went
live: redeploys that keep the version keep the date. It is null on a
revision deployed before the deploy recorded it, outside Cloud Run, or
when the version the deploy dated is not the installed one.

EconomyResult.title: EconomyResult
EconomyResult.description:
A report run's single-year economy result, in the format the app reads.

``model_version`` is the country package version the run used, and
``data_version`` the data release. ``spm_provenance`` is the baseline's
and reform's SPM calculation receipts the simulation service stored, as
the Public API's ``SPMComparisonProvenance`` (serialized, as the Public
API serializes it elsewhere, with package names as its runtime version
keys), or null. ``wealth_decile`` and ``intra_wealth_decile`` are UK-only;
``poverty_by_race`` and ``congressional_district_impact`` US-only; the
constituency and local-authority impacts are UK-only and null when the
run did not compute them. ``labor_supply_response`` and ``cliff_impact``
are null when the run did not compute them.

GenderPoverty.title: GenderPoverty
GenderPoverty.description: Poverty rates for males and females.

HealthNotReadyResponse.title: HealthNotReadyResponse
HealthNotReadyResponse.description: Health-check result while warmup runs or the configuration is invalid.

HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse
HealthResponse.description: Health-check result showing that the API has warmed up and can serve requests.

HouseholdCalculationAxis.title: HouseholdCalculationAxis
HouseholdCalculationAxis.description:
One input varied across points.

The variable ``name`` takes ``count`` evenly spaced values from ``min`` to
``max`` in ``period`` (the household's ``default_year`` when omitted), for
the entity member at position ``index`` (the first when omitted).

HouseholdCalculationErrorItem.title: HouseholdCalculationErrorItem
HouseholdCalculationErrorItem.description:
Why a calculation failed.

``code`` is the household function's error code: ``invalid_inputs``,
with ``input_errors`` naming each input the country model does not
recognize; ``invalid_household``; ``invalid_spm_selection``, with
``spm_error``; ``bundle_mismatch``; or ``calculation_failed``. It is null
when the calculation failed for another reason, such as a household
function that raised or was cancelled; ``message`` is then the job's
one-line error, such as ``household_function_error: …`` or
``household_function_cancelled: …``, and submitting again may succeed.

HouseholdCalculationItem.title: HouseholdCalculationItem
HouseholdCalculationItem.description:
A household calculation and its outcome.

``status`` moves from ``pending`` through ``running`` to ``succeeded``,
with ``result``, or ``failed``, with ``error``. ``catalog_version_id``,
``country_package_version`` and ``policyengine_version`` are those the
calculation runs with.

HouseholdCalculationOutputItem.title: HouseholdCalculationOutputItem
HouseholdCalculationOutputItem.description:
A succeeded calculation's household.

``household`` is the stored household in the situation shape (people and
groups keyed by their record IDs) with each calculated value filled in by
period. ``warnings`` lists inputs the country model ignored. In the US,
``spm_config`` is the SPM selection the calculation applied and
``spm_provenance`` its receipt; both are null elsewhere.

HouseholdCalculationRequest.title: HouseholdCalculationRequest
HouseholdCalculationRequest.description:
A stored household to calculate under a stored policy, or current law.

``household_id`` and ``policy_id`` name records of ``country_id`` stored
through ``/v2/households`` and ``/v2/policies``; without ``policy_id`` the
household is calculated under current law, for the household's
``default_year``. Each group in ``axes`` varies its inputs together across
``count`` points; several groups form a grid of at most 10,000 points.
``add_missing_variables`` adds every variable the household lacks before
calculating. ``spm`` selects the SPM forecast scenario and geography for
a US household. Each submission starts a new calculation.

HouseholdCalculationSubmittedItem.title: HouseholdCalculationSubmittedItem
HouseholdCalculationSubmittedItem.description:
A calculation the simulation service accepted.

Poll ``GET /v2/household-calculations/{calculation_id}`` until ``status``
is ``succeeded`` or ``failed``. ``year`` is the household's default year,
which is calculated.

HouseholdCalculationSubmittedResponse.title: HouseholdCalculationSubmittedResponse
HouseholdCalculationSubmittedResponse.description: Success response holding the accepted calculation.

HouseholdCalculationSubmittedResult.title: HouseholdCalculationSubmittedResult
HouseholdCalculationSubmittedResult.description: Result holding the accepted calculation in ``item``.

default_year.title: Default Year
default_year.description: Default year for values without explicit period keys

HouseholdCreateRequest.title: HouseholdCreateRequest
HouseholdCreateRequest.description: Native immutable household content with no presentation or model fields.

HouseholdEntityRecord.title: HouseholdEntityRecord
HouseholdEntityRecord.description:
One group entity in a household, such as a tax unit or a benefit unit.

``id`` is unique within its collection and is what people's ``memberships``
refer to. ``values`` maps variable names to values, and ``source_name``
optionally keeps the entity's original name, such as its key in a v1 household.

anyOf.description: Default year for values without explicit period keys

HouseholdItem.title: HouseholdItem
HouseholdItem.description:
A stored household.

Households are immutable and deduplicated: creating one with identical
content returns the existing household and its ``id``.

HouseholdPageResponse.title: HouseholdPageResponse
HouseholdPageResponse.description: Success response holding one page of households.

HouseholdPageResult.title: HouseholdPageResult
HouseholdPageResult.description:
One page of households, oldest first.

``offset`` and ``limit`` echo the request; when ``has_more`` is true, ask
for the next page with ``offset + limit``.

HouseholdPersonRecord.title: HouseholdPersonRecord
HouseholdPersonRecord.description:
One person in a household.

``memberships`` maps each of the country's entity collections to the ``id``
of the group the person belongs to, and must name every collection.

InequalityChange.title: InequalityChange
InequalityChange.description: The Gini coefficient and the top 10% and top 1% income shares.

IntraDecileShares.title: IntraDecileShares
IntraDecileShares.description:
Shares of people in each decile who gain or lose, by size of the change.

``deciles`` lists each category's share for deciles 1 to 10 in order, and
``all`` is each category's mean over those deciles.

InvitationAcceptRequest.title: InvitationAcceptRequest
InvitationAcceptRequest.description: The token from an invitation's link, from its ``#token=`` fragment.

InvitationAcceptanceItem.title: InvitationAcceptanceItem
InvitationAcceptanceItem.description:
The user's type after accepting an invitation, and before.

``type_changed`` is false when the user already had the invited type or a
higher one: an invitation never lowers a type.

InvitationAcceptanceResponse.title: InvitationAcceptanceResponse
InvitationAcceptanceResponse.description: Success response holding an accepted invitation's outcome.

InvitationAcceptanceResult.title: InvitationAcceptanceResult
InvitationAcceptanceResult.description: Result holding the accepted invitation's outcome in ``item``.

InvitationCreateRequest.title: InvitationCreateRequest
InvitationCreateRequest.description:
The address an admin invites, and the type the invitation grants.

``email`` is stripped of surrounding whitespace and must be one address:
an @ with text on both sides and no whitespace, < or >.

LaborSupplyDecileValues.title: LaborSupplyDecileValues
LaborSupplyDecileValues.description: Income- and substitution-effect responses by income decile number.

LaborSupplyDeciles.title: LaborSupplyDeciles
LaborSupplyDeciles.description: Labour supply responses by decile: per household, and relative to earnings.

LaborSupplyHours.title: LaborSupplyHours
LaborSupplyHours.description: Total weekly hours under the baseline and reform, and the change's effects.

LaborSupplyRelativeResponse.title: LaborSupplyRelativeResponse
LaborSupplyRelativeResponse.description: Income- and substitution-effect responses relative to baseline earnings.

LaborSupplyResponse.title: LaborSupplyResponse
LaborSupplyResponse.description:
The behavioural labour supply response to the reform.

``income_lsr`` and ``substitution_lsr`` are the earnings changes from the
two effects, and ``total_change`` their sum.

LatestTypeChangeItem.title: LatestTypeChangeItem
LatestTypeChangeItem.description: The user's most recent type change, from ``previous_user_type``.

LocalAuthorityImpact.title: LocalAuthorityImpact
LocalAuthorityImpact.description: The reform's impact in one UK local authority.

MeDetailResponse.title: MeDetailResponse
MeDetailResponse.description: Success response holding the current user.

MeDetailResult.title: MeDetailResult
MeDetailResult.description: Result holding the current user in ``item``.

MeExportResponse.title: MeExportResponse
MeExportResponse.description: Success response holding the current user's export.

MeExportResult.title: MeExportResult
MeExportResult.description:
The current user and every policy, household, simulation and report it saved.

The export covers every country, not only the requested one.

MeItem.title: MeItem
MeItem.description:
The current user: a signed-in account or a browser's unauthenticated user.

``user_type`` says which: ``unauthenticated``, or the signed-in user's
stored type, ``standard``, ``author`` or ``admin``, where each type has
every permission of the types before it. An unauthenticated user has no
primary country, and only a signed-in user can set its names or primary
country.

MeReadResponse.title: MeReadResponse
MeReadResponse.description: Success response holding the current user and their latest type change.

MeReadResult.title: MeReadResult
MeReadResult.description:
The current user, and their most recent type change until it is dismissed.

``latest_type_change`` is null when the user's type never changed, when
its most recent change was dismissed, and for an unauthenticated user.

MeUpgradeResponse.title: MeUpgradeResponse
MeUpgradeResponse.description: Success response holding the signed-in account after an upgrade.

MeUpgradeResult.title: MeUpgradeResult
MeUpgradeResult.description:
The signed-in account after a browser's unauthenticated user moved into it.

``outcome`` is ``converted`` when the unauthenticated user became the account
in place, ``merged`` when its records moved to an existing account, and
``none`` when there was no unauthenticated user to move.

MetadataCanonicalParameterValue.title: MetadataCanonicalParameterValue
MetadataCanonicalParameterValue.description:
One current-law value of a parameter.

The value applies from start_date until end_date, or indefinitely when
end_date is null.

MetadataCatalogParameter.title: MetadataCatalogParameter
MetadataCatalogParameter.description: A parameter with its current-law values in start-date order.

MetadataCatalogParametersResponse.title: MetadataCatalogParametersResponse
MetadataCatalogParametersResponse.description: Success response holding parameters fetched by name, with their values.

MetadataCatalogParametersResult.title: MetadataCatalogParametersResult
MetadataCatalogParametersResult.description:
Requested parameters of one catalog version, in name order.

node_labels maps each ancestor of a requested parameter that the version
stores as a parameter node to the node's stored label (null when it has
none), for breadcrumbs; a bracket index such as ``rates[0]`` counts as a
child of its schedule ``rates``. missing_names lists requested names the
version has no parameter for.

MetadataCatalogVariablesResponse.title: MetadataCatalogVariablesResponse
MetadataCatalogVariablesResponse.description: Success response holding every variable of one catalog version.

MetadataCatalogVariablesResult.title: MetadataCatalogVariablesResult
MetadataCatalogVariablesResult.description:
Every variable of one catalog version, in name order.

part_parameter_values has an entry for each parameter path a variable's
adds_parameter_path or subtracts_parameter_path names: that parameter's
current-law values in start-date order, or an empty list when the
catalog has no such parameter.

MetadataDataset.title: MetadataDataset
MetadataDataset.description:
A named input dataset available to the selected model version.

These datasets are logical inputs, so storage_path is always null and
is_output_dataset is always false.

MetadataDatasetOption.title: MetadataDatasetOption
MetadataDatasetOption.description: The national dataset, offered as the default for an economy calculation.

MetadataDatasetPageResponse.title: MetadataDatasetPageResponse
MetadataDatasetPageResponse.description: Success response holding one page of datasets.

MetadataDatedValue.title: MetadataDatedValue
MetadataDatedValue.description:
A current-law parameter value from start_date until end_date.

A null end_date means the value applies until a later value starts, or
indefinitely.

MetadataEconomyOptions.title: MetadataEconomyOptions
MetadataEconomyOptions.description:
The region, year and dataset choices for an economy calculation.

Every list is empty for a catalog without regions, such as a
household-only country's, which offers no economy calculation.

MetadataEconomyOptionsResponse.title: MetadataEconomyOptionsResponse
MetadataEconomyOptionsResponse.description: Success response holding the options for configuring an economy comparison.

MetadataEconomyOptionsResult.title: MetadataEconomyOptionsResult
MetadataEconomyOptionsResult.description:
The choices for configuring an economy calculation.

It lists the selectable regions, years and datasets, and the id of the
current-law policy to use as a baseline.

MetadataEntity.title: MetadataEntity
MetadataEntity.description:
A kind of member a household holds, such as a person or a tax unit.

plural is the key the household's members of this kind are listed under,
and is_person marks the entity every household input about a person uses.

MetadataEnumValue.title: MetadataEnumValue
MetadataEnumValue.description:
One value of an enum variable: its stored name and its display label.

The label keeps the type the country package declares it with.

MetadataModel.title: MetadataModel
MetadataModel.description: A country's tax-benefit model in the selected PolicyEngine.py catalog.

MetadataModelCatalogResponse.title: MetadataModelCatalogResponse
MetadataModelCatalogResponse.description: Success response holding the small parts of one catalog version.

MetadataModelCatalogResult.title: MetadataModelCatalogResult
MetadataModelCatalogResult.description:
The small parts of one catalog version, read when a client starts.

policyengine_version names the selected catalog version, so a client can
request its other parts for that exact version. catalog_format is null,
and entities and basic_inputs are empty, for a version published before
catalog format 2. ``spm`` says whether the version offers SPM settings.
Variables, parameters and their values are served by their own routes.

MetadataModelDetailResponse.title: MetadataModelDetailResponse
MetadataModelDetailResponse.description: Success response holding one tax-benefit model.

MetadataModelPageResponse.title: MetadataModelPageResponse
MetadataModelPageResponse.description:
Success response holding a page of the selected catalog's tax-benefit models.

A catalog has one model per country, so only the first page has an item.

MetadataModelSelectionResponse.title: MetadataModelSelectionResponse
MetadataModelSelectionResponse.description: Success response holding a country's model and its selected model version.

MetadataModelSelectionResult.title: MetadataModelSelectionResult
MetadataModelSelectionResult.description: A country's model together with the model version selected for the request.

MetadataModelVersionDetail.title: MetadataModelVersionDetail
MetadataModelVersionDetail.description: A model version, with its current-law policy id and the years offered.

MetadataModelVersionDetailResponse.title: MetadataModelVersionDetailResponse
MetadataModelVersionDetailResponse.description: Success response holding one model version.

MetadataModelVersionPageResponse.title: MetadataModelVersionPageResponse
MetadataModelVersionPageResponse.description:
Success response holding a page of the selected catalog's model versions.

A catalog has one model version, so only the first page has an item.

MetadataParameterChild.title: MetadataParameterChild
MetadataParameterChild.description:
A direct child in the parameter tree.

A node has a child_count; a parameter leaf carries the parameter's summary.

MetadataParameterChildPageResponse.title: MetadataParameterChildPageResponse
MetadataParameterChildPageResponse.description: Success response holding one page of a parameter path's direct children.

MetadataParameterPageResponse.title: MetadataParameterPageResponse
MetadataParameterPageResponse.description: Success response holding one page of parameters.

MetadataParameterSearchFileContent.title: MetadataParameterSearchFileContent
MetadataParameterSearchFileContent.description:
One catalog version's parameter search file, ordered by path.

It holds what v3's parameter search reads, without the catalog's values.
A reader applies v1's label fallback where a label is null.

MetadataParameterSearchFileEditabilityCh.title: MetadataParameterSearchFileEditabilityChange
MetadataParameterSearchFileEditabilityCh.description: From ``start_date`` (an ISO date), whether a draft can edit the value.

MetadataParameterSearchFileLabel.title: MetadataParameterSearchFileLabel
MetadataParameterSearchFileLabel.description: Another parameter under ``gov``: its path and stored label, or null.

MetadataParameterSearchFileNode.title: MetadataParameterSearchFileNode
MetadataParameterSearchFileNode.description: ``gov`` or a node under it that has a stored label.

MetadataParameterSearchFileParameter.title: MetadataParameterSearchFileParameter
MetadataParameterSearchFileParameter.description:
A parameter a reform can change, with what v3's search indexes.

``label`` is the stored label, or null when none is stored. ``editable``
says whether a draft can edit the earliest current-law value (a number, a
yes/no value or an infinite threshold); ``editable_changes``, present only
when that changes over time and never null, lists the dates from which it
changes.

MetadataParameterSummary.title: MetadataParameterSummary
MetadataParameterSummary.description:
A policy parameter, described without its values.

Its current-law values are listed by GET /v2/parameter-values. economy and
household say whether a reform of an economy or of a household may change
it; they are null in versions published before catalog format 2.

MetadataParameterValueDetailResponse.title: MetadataParameterValueDetailResponse
MetadataParameterValueDetailResponse.description: Success response holding one parameter value.

MetadataParameterValuePageResponse.title: MetadataParameterValuePageResponse
MetadataParameterValuePageResponse.description: Success response holding one page of parameter values.

MetadataRegion.title: MetadataRegion
MetadataRegion.description:
A region the model can simulate, such as a country, state or constituency.

When requires_filter is true, filter_strategy says how the region selects
households of its default dataset. With "row_filter", it keeps the
households whose filter_field column equals filter_value (or is in it,
when filter_value is a JSON list).

MetadataRegionOption.title: MetadataRegionOption
MetadataRegionOption.description: A region that can be chosen for an economy calculation; name is its code.

MetadataRegionPageResponse.title: MetadataRegionPageResponse
MetadataRegionPageResponse.description: Success response holding one page of regions.

MetadataRegionType.title: MetadataRegionType
MetadataRegionType.description: The geographic level of a region.

MetadataSPMAvailability.title: MetadataSPMAvailability
MetadataSPMAvailability.description:
Whether a catalog version offers SPM settings for a household.

When ``available``, ``settings_schema`` is the JSON schema of a
household's ``spm`` selection and ``defaults`` the certified selection
that applies to every field a household leaves out. A version without
them (any country but the US, or a bundle without certified SPM
support) is not available, and both are null. ``available`` is null
while catalog publication has not recorded the version's availability,
because the simulation service didn't serve its PolicyEngine.py version
or its versions couldn't be read: whether it offers SPM settings is not
known yet.

MetadataTimePeriodOption.title: MetadataTimePeriodOption
MetadataTimePeriodOption.description: A year that can be chosen for an economy calculation.

MetadataVariable.title: MetadataVariable
MetadataVariable.description:
A variable the tax-benefit model computes or accepts as input.

adds and subtracts, when present, list the variables summed into or
subtracted from this one. When the model takes that list from a
parameter, adds_parameter_path or subtracts_parameter_path names the
parameter, whose dated values give the list for each year (adds and
subtracts hold its value on 2025-01-01). unit is the country package's
unit (for example ``currency-USD``) and definition_period the period a
value covers (``year``, ``month`` or ``eternity``). The catalog format 2
fields (is_input_variable, hidden_input, module_name, the two parameter
paths, enum_values, unit and definition_period) are null in versions
published before that format.

MetadataVariablePageResponse.title: MetadataVariablePageResponse
MetadataVariablePageResponse.description: Success response holding one page of variables.

PackageVersionsItem.title: PackageVersionsItem
PackageVersionsItem.description: A country package version and the PolicyEngine.py version beside it.

PolicyChoice.title: PolicyChoice
PolicyChoice.description: A simulation's stored policy and dynamic; neither means current law.

PolicyCreateRequest.title: PolicyCreateRequest
PolicyCreateRequest.description: Native body containing immutable policy content only.

missing_parameters.title: Missing Parameters
missing_parameters.description: The parameter paths this policy sets that the current tax-benefit model (the catalog of the running PolicyEngine.py version) no longer has, sorted; empty when it has them all. Null when that catalog is not published, so nothing could be checked. A policy with missing parameters cannot be run on the current model.

PolicyItem.title: PolicyItem
PolicyItem.description:
A stored policy: parameter values for one tax-benefit model.

Policies are immutable and deduplicated: creating one with identical
content returns the existing policy and its ``id``.

PolicyPageResponse.title: PolicyPageResponse
PolicyPageResponse.description: Success response holding one page of policies.

PolicyPageResult.title: PolicyPageResult
PolicyPageResult.description:
One page of policies, oldest first.

``offset`` and ``limit`` echo the request; when ``has_more`` is true, ask
for the next page with ``offset + limit``.

PolicyParameterValueInput.title: PolicyParameterValueInput
PolicyParameterValueInput.description: One normalized effective value for a catalog parameter UUID.

PolicyParameterValueItem.title: PolicyParameterValueItem
PolicyParameterValueItem.description:
One value a policy sets for a parameter from ``start_date``.

``parameter_name`` is the parameter's path in the model, and a null
``end_date`` means the value has no end.

PolicyProvenance.title: PolicyProvenance
PolicyProvenance.description: Where a v3 reform came from.

PolicyProvenanceItem.title: PolicyProvenanceItem
PolicyProvenanceItem.description:
Stored v3 reform provenance as responses publish it.

It mirrors the contract without the input bounds and ignores unknown keys,
so any stored row serializes.

PovertyByAge.title: PovertyByAge
PovertyByAge.description:
Poverty and deep poverty rates by age group.

In the US these are the SPM poverty and deep SPM poverty rates; in the UK,
relative and absolute poverty before housing costs.

PovertyByGender.title: PovertyByGender
PovertyByGender.description: Poverty and deep poverty rates by gender.

PovertyByRace.title: PovertyByRace
PovertyByRace.description: US poverty rates by race; there is no deep poverty breakdown.

ProgramBudget.title: ProgramBudget
ProgramBudget.description:
One program's baseline and reform totals, and reform minus baseline.

``is_tax`` says whether the program is a tax or a benefit, and is null for
results stored before the flag was recorded.

RacePoverty.title: RacePoverty
RacePoverty.description: US poverty rates by race and ethnicity.

ReportCalibration.title: ReportCalibration
ReportCalibration.description: Calibration results for one geography, with at most 500 variable matches.

ReportCalibrationItem.title: ReportCalibrationItem
ReportCalibrationItem.description: Calibration results saved with a report, for one geography and data release.

ReportCalibrationMatch.title: ReportCalibrationMatch
ReportCalibrationMatch.description:
Calibration of one variable: how closely its targets are met.

``ring`` is ``primary``, ``mechanism`` or ``downstream``.
``mean_abs_relative_error`` is averaged over the variable's ``target_count``
targets, and ``worst`` is the target with the largest error.

ReportCalibrationMatchItem.title: ReportCalibrationMatchItem
ReportCalibrationMatchItem.description: One variable's calibration match: its targets, mean error and worst target.

ReportCalibrationWorst.title: ReportCalibrationWorst
ReportCalibrationWorst.description: The calibration target a match fits worst, with its source and geography.

ReportCalibrationWorstItem.title: ReportCalibrationWorstItem
ReportCalibrationWorstItem.description: The calibration target that one match fits worst, with its relative error.

ReportCreateRequest.title: ReportCreateRequest
ReportCreateRequest.description:
An economy report to create; ``country_id`` must match the query's.

Each simulation's empty object is current law. No field names a
PolicyEngine.py version: the simulation service runs its default
worker's.

ReportItem.title: ReportItem
ReportItem.description:
An economy report with its newest run's result.

``result`` is the single-year economy result, in the format the app reads
today, once the newest run has succeeded, and null otherwise.

ReportListResponse.title: ReportListResponse
ReportListResponse.description: Success response holding the listed reports.

ReportListResult.title: ReportListResult
ReportListResult.description: The listed reports in ``items``, in the order named, without results.

ReportProvision.title: ReportProvision
ReportProvision.description:
One provision of the report's reform: a parameter's baseline and reform values.

``path`` is the parameter path and ``breadcrumb`` its readable label, and
``intervals`` optionally gives a dated schedule. ``growth`` says how a value
set from one year on moves in later years (``fixed``, ``current_law`` or an
index's parameter path); the other ``growth_*`` fields say when it moves and
how grown values round. They are absent for a hand-set schedule.

ReportProvisionInterval.title: ReportProvisionInterval
ReportProvisionInterval.description:
One dated value in a provision's schedule, from ``start_date`` to ``end_date``.

Dates are ``YYYY-MM-DD`` strings and ``value`` is any finite JSON value.
``parameter`` is optional, and is left out of the stored report when unset.

ReportProvisionIntervalItem.title: ReportProvisionIntervalItem
ReportProvisionIntervalItem.description: A provision's value for the dates from ``start_date`` to ``end_date``.

ReportProvisionItem.title: ReportProvisionItem
ReportProvisionItem.description:
One parameter the report's reform changes, with its baseline and reform values.

``intervals`` gives the reform's dated values when they vary over time. The
``growth`` keys, present only when set, say how a value set from one year on
moves in later years and how grown values round.

ReportRunItem.title: ReportRunItem
ReportRunItem.description:
One calculation of a report, on one country package and .py version.

``status`` is ``pending``, ``running``, ``succeeded`` or ``failed``, and
``error_message`` says why a failed run failed. ``trigger`` is
``initial`` for the run the report's creation started.

ReportScorecard.title: ReportScorecard
ReportScorecard.description: The programs on the report's validation scorecard, at most 200 names.

ReportScorecardItem.title: ReportScorecardItem
ReportScorecardItem.description: The programs on the scorecard saved with a report's validation.

ReportSimulationItem.title: ReportSimulationItem
ReportSimulationItem.description: A simulation a report compares; a null policy or dynamic is current law.

ReportSummaryItem.title: ReportSummaryItem
ReportSummaryItem.description:
An economy report comparing a baseline and a reform simulation.

``status`` is the newest run's, or ``not_run`` for a report with no run.
``run`` is the newest run, whatever its status and versions;
``current_versions`` are the versions the Public API runs now, so a
newest run on other versions is out of date. ``options`` are the options
the report was created with.

ReportValidation.title: ReportValidation
ReportValidation.description:
The validation snapshot saved with a report.

``calibration`` and ``scorecard`` are optional, and the stored snapshot keeps
only the keys supplied.

ReportValidationItem.title: ReportValidationItem
ReportValidationItem.description:
The validation snapshot saved with a report.

It records when the report was matched and with which map model version,
and optionally the calibration results and scorecard.

SPMComparisonProvenance.title: SPMComparisonProvenance
SPMComparisonProvenance.description: Compact baseline and reform receipts for a society-wide result.

SPMExecutionProvenance.title: SPMExecutionProvenance
SPMExecutionProvenance.description: One shared compact receipt and the executions that produced it.

SPMProvenance.title: SPMProvenance
SPMProvenance.description: Compact public receipt for one canonical SPM execution.

SPMRuntimeVersions.title: SPMRuntimeVersions
SPMRuntimeVersions.description: Package versions required to reproduce one certified SPM execution.

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD); must satisfy the selected artifact's information date

SPMSelection.title: SPMSelection
SPMSelection.description: Select a forecast scenario and an explicit household SPM geography.

SharedBaselineReformItem.title: SharedBaselineReformItem
SharedBaselineReformItem.description: The saved reform a shared report was compared with, named but not linked.

SharedUserReportDetailResponse.title: SharedUserReportDetailResponse
SharedUserReportDetailResponse.description: Success response holding one shared report.

SharedUserReportDetailResult.title: SharedUserReportDetailResult
SharedUserReportDetailResult.description: Result holding one shared report in ``item``.

SharedUserReportItem.title: SharedUserReportItem
SharedUserReportItem.description:
A saved report as anyone holding its link reads it.

``report_id`` is the detailed-save report it shows, and
``legacy_report_id`` the v1 report output; one of them is set.

SimulationCreateRequest.title: SimulationCreateRequest
SimulationCreateRequest.description:
An economy simulation to create; ``country_id`` must match the query's.

No field names a PolicyEngine.py version: the simulation service runs its
default worker's.

SimulationItem.title: SimulationItem
SimulationItem.description:
A simulation, its newest run and the versions the Public API runs now.

A null ``policy_id`` or ``dynamic_id`` is current law. An economy
simulation names its region and dataset, a household simulation its
household. ``status`` is the newest run's, or ``not_run``; a newest run
on other versions than ``current_versions`` is out of date.

SimulationRunItem.title: SimulationRunItem
SimulationRunItem.description: One calculation of a simulation, for one year on one package version pair.

UKHouseholdDocument.title: UKHouseholdDocument
UKHouseholdDocument.description: UK household content: people, households and benefit units.

USHouseholdDocument-Input.title: USHouseholdDocument
USHouseholdDocument-Input.description:
US household content: people and the US group entities they belong to.

``spm`` optionally selects an SPM forecast scenario and geography; omit it
rather than sending null.

UnavailableAfterReportCreatedResponse.title: UnavailableAfterReportCreatedResponse
UnavailableAfterReportCreatedResponse.description:
The 503 answer when the simulation service failed a new report's run.

The message gives the service's status and code. ``report_id`` names the
report, which ``GET /v2/reports/{report_id}`` reads with its failed run.

UnavailableAfterSimulationCreatedRespons.title: UnavailableAfterSimulationCreatedResponse
UnavailableAfterSimulationCreatedRespons.description:
The 503 answer when the simulation service failed a new simulation's run.

The message gives the service's status and code. ``simulation_id`` names
the simulation, which ``GET /v2/simulations/{simulation_id}`` reads with
its failed run.

anyOf.description: Exact v1 database identifier (a JSON integer)

UserHouseholdCreateRequest.title: UserHouseholdCreateRequest
UserHouseholdCreateRequest.description: Association fields; the owner is taken from the request credential.

UserHouseholdDetailResponse.title: UserHouseholdDetailResponse
UserHouseholdDetailResponse.description: Success response holding one user-household association.

UserHouseholdDetailResult.title: UserHouseholdDetailResult
UserHouseholdDetailResult.description: Result holding one user-household association in ``item``.

UserHouseholdItem.title: UserHouseholdItem
UserHouseholdItem.description:
A household saved by a v2 user, with the user's name and description for it.

Unlike households, associations can be renamed, pointed at another
household of the same country, or deleted.

UserHouseholdPageResponse.title: UserHouseholdPageResponse
UserHouseholdPageResponse.description: Success response holding one page of user-household associations.

UserHouseholdPageResult.title: UserHouseholdPageResult
UserHouseholdPageResult.description:
One page of user-household associations, oldest first.

``offset`` and ``limit`` echo the request; when ``has_more`` is true, ask
for the next page with ``offset + limit``.

anyOf.description: Exact v1 database identifier (a JSON integer)

UserHouseholdPatchRequest.title: UserHouseholdPatchRequest
UserHouseholdPatchRequest.description: Explicitly supplied mutable link or presentation fields.

anyOf.description: Exact v1 database identifier (a JSON integer)

UserPolicyCreateRequest.title: UserPolicyCreateRequest
UserPolicyCreateRequest.description: Association fields; the owner is taken from the request credential.

UserPolicyDetailResponse.title: UserPolicyDetailResponse
UserPolicyDetailResponse.description: Success response holding one user-policy association.

UserPolicyDetailResult.title: UserPolicyDetailResult
UserPolicyDetailResult.description: Result holding one user-policy association in ``item``.

UserPolicyItem.title: UserPolicyItem
UserPolicyItem.description:
A policy saved by a v2 user, with the user's name and description for it.

Unlike policies, associations can be renamed or deleted.

UserPolicyPageResponse.title: UserPolicyPageResponse
UserPolicyPageResponse.description: Success response holding one page of user-policy associations.

UserPolicyPageResult.title: UserPolicyPageResult
UserPolicyPageResult.description:
One page of user-policy associations, oldest first.

``offset`` and ``limit`` echo the request; when ``has_more`` is true, ask
for the next page with ``offset + limit``.

anyOf.description: Exact v1 database identifier (a JSON integer)

UserPolicyPatchRequest.title: UserPolicyPatchRequest
UserPolicyPatchRequest.description: Explicitly supplied mutable link or presentation fields.

anyOf.description: Exact v1 database identifier (a JSON integer)

UserReportCreateRequest.title: UserReportCreateRequest
UserReportCreateRequest.description: Association fields; the owner is taken from the request credential.

UserReportDetailResponse.title: UserReportDetailResponse
UserReportDetailResponse.description: Success response holding one user-report association.

UserReportDetailResult.title: UserReportDetailResult
UserReportDetailResult.description: Result holding one user-report association in ``item``.

UserReportItem.title: UserReportItem
UserReportItem.description:
A report saved by a user, with the user's name, notes and saved presentation.

``report_id`` is the detailed-save report it shows, and
``legacy_report_id`` the v1 report output; one of them is set, and only
saved reports the production migration wrote hold both. ``user_policy_id`` is
the user's saved reform the report was run from, and
``baseline_user_policy_id`` the saved reform it was compared with instead of
current law; each is null when not set or once that reform is deleted.
``budget_window_years`` is null for a report without a budget window.

UserReportPageResponse.title: UserReportPageResponse
UserReportPageResponse.description: Success response holding one page of user-report associations.

UserReportPageResult.title: UserReportPageResult
UserReportPageResult.description:
One page of user-report associations, oldest first.

``offset`` and ``limit`` echo the request; when ``has_more`` is true, ask
for the next page with ``offset + limit``.

anyOf.description: Exact v1 database identifier (a JSON integer)

UserReportPatchRequest.title: UserReportPatchRequest
UserReportPatchRequest.description: Explicitly supplied mutable link or presentation fields.

anyOf.description: Exact v1 database identifier (a JSON integer)

UserSimulationCreateRequest.title: UserSimulationCreateRequest
UserSimulationCreateRequest.description: Association fields; the owner is taken from the request credential.

UserSimulationDetailResponse.title: UserSimulationDetailResponse
UserSimulationDetailResponse.description: Success response holding one user-simulation association.

UserSimulationDetailResult.title: UserSimulationDetailResult
UserSimulationDetailResult.description: Result holding one user-simulation association in ``item``.

UserSimulationItem.title: UserSimulationItem
UserSimulationItem.description:
A simulation saved by a user, with the user's name and description for it.

``simulation_id`` is the detailed-save simulation it saves, and
``legacy_simulation_id`` the v1 simulation; one of them is set, and only
saved simulations the production migration wrote hold both. Associations
can be renamed or deleted, and pointed at another simulation of the same
country through the reference they hold: another detailed-save simulation
through ``simulation_id``, another v1 simulation through
``legacy_simulation_id``. An update that would leave both set is refused,
and the simulation's own kind (economy or household) is not checked.

UserTypeChangeItem.title: UserTypeChangeItem
UserTypeChangeItem.description:
One recorded change of a signed-in user's type.

``source`` is ``admin_route`` for a change an admin made through these
routes, named by ``changed_by_user_id`` and ``changed_by_email``,
``invitation`` for one the user made by accepting an admin's email
invitation, which names that admin, and ``script`` for one the type
script made, which names no admin. ``changed_by_user_id`` is also null
once that admin's account is deleted.
``changed_by_email`` is read from Auth0 like an admin user item's email,
else stored.

UserTypeChangeListResponse.description: The response for a signed-in user's recorded type changes.

UserTypeChangeListResult.title: UserTypeChangeListResult
UserTypeChangeListResult.description: A signed-in user's recorded type changes, newest first.

UserTypePatchRequest.title: UserTypePatchRequest
UserTypePatchRequest.description:
The signed-in type an admin gives a user, and the type the admin last read.

expected_user_type is the user's type as the admin last read it. When the
request would change the type and the stored type differs from
expected_user_type, the change is refused (409) and nothing is written.
When the user already has user_type, nothing changes (200), whatever
expected_user_type is. Only the type is compared: a type changed and
changed back since the read is not detected.

An error that also names its reason with a stable ``code``.

Clients choose what to do from ``code``, not from ``message``, which is
for people and may change.

V2MissingParametersErrorResponse.description:
A refused calculation whose policy sets parameters the catalog lacks.

``missing_parameters`` names each parameter the policy sets that the
running catalog version does not have, sorted; the calculation would
otherwise run without those values.
